text: Over the past two years, my office has been working with City staff to move forward on a number of priorities this community has raised about student safety. These parking amendments proposed will make school pick-up/drop-off safer for everyone. At my request, and on behalf of Jean Lumb Public School and Bishop Macdonell Catholic Elementary School, staff were asked to consider implementing a passenger loading area on Brunel Court for pick-up/drop-off (PUDO) activities. Both schools have reported that not having a designated passenger loading area had led to parents and guardians parking in the school bus loading zone (SBLZ) and on nearby private property, which obstructs school bus loading activities and motorists entering/exiting their condominium property at 15 Brunel Court.
